# Workshop Satisfaction Survey

<!-- BREADRUMB PLACEHOLDER -->

---

> Comprehensive participant feedback template for measuring immediate workshop reactions, satisfaction levels, and perceived value. Use immediately after workshop completion.

---
page_texts.3:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/workshop-satisfaction-survey.md#purpose-and-scope]

### Purpose and Scope

**Survey Objectives:**

- Measure participant satisfaction with workshop experience
- Assess perceived value and relevance of content
- Evaluate facilitation effectiveness and engagement
- Identify improvement opportunities for future workshops
- Capture immediate reactions and emotional responses

**Target Audience:** All workshop participants
**Timing:** Immediately after workshop completion (within 24 hours)
**Duration:** 10-15 minutes to complete
**Format:** Digital survey (web-based) or printed form
page_texts.4:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/workshop-satisfaction-survey.md#survey-structure]

### Survey Structure

**Section 1:** Overall Experience (5 questions)
**Section 2:** Content Quality and Relevance (6 questions)
**Section 3:** Facilitation Effectiveness (5 questions)
**Section 4:** Learning and Value (4 questions)
**Section 5:** Logistics and Environment (4 questions)
**Section 6:** Future Recommendations (3 questions)
**Section 7:** Open-Ended Feedback (3 questions)

**Total Questions:** 30 (20 quantitative + 10 qualitative)

---

[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/workshop-satisfaction-survey.md#section-1-overall-experience]

### Section 1: Overall Experience

**1.1 Overall Workshop Rating**
How would you rate your overall experience with this workshop?

- [ ] Excellent (5) - Exceeded all expectations
- [ ] Very Good (4) - Met most expectations with some exceeding
- [ ] Good (3) - Met basic expectations
- [ ] Fair (2) - Met some expectations, disappointed in others
- [ ] Poor (1) - Did not meet expectations

**1.2 Recommendation Likelihood**
How likely are you to recommend this workshop to a colleague?

- [ ] Extremely Likely (10-9) - Strong advocate
- [ ] Likely (8-7) - Would recommend with enthusiasm
- [ ] Neutral (6-5) - Might recommend in certain circumstances
- [ ] Unlikely (4-3) - Would not actively recommend
- [ ] Extremely Unlikely (2-1) - Would discourage attendance

**1.3 Time Investment Value**
Considering the time you invested, how valuable was this workshop?

- [ ] Extremely Valuable (5) - Excellent use of time
- [ ] Very Valuable (4) - Good use of time
- [ ] Somewhat Valuable (3) - Adequate use of time
- [ ] Slightly Valuable (2) - Limited value for time spent
- [ ] Not Valuable (1) - Poor use of time

**1.4 Expectation Alignment**
How well did the workshop meet your pre-workshop expectations?

- [ ] Significantly Exceeded (5)
- [ ] Somewhat Exceeded (4)
- [ ] Met Expectations (3)
- [ ] Somewhat Below (2)
- [ ] Significantly Below (1)

**1.5 Engagement Level**
How engaged did you feel throughout the workshop?

- [ ] Highly Engaged (5) - Actively participated throughout
- [ ] Mostly Engaged (4) - Participated in most activities
- [ ] Moderately Engaged (3) - Participated when asked
- [ ] Somewhat Disengaged (2) - Limited participation
- [ ] Disengaged (1) - Minimal participation

[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/workshop-satisfaction-survey.md#section-2-content-quality-and-relevance]

### Section 2: Content Quality and Relevance

**2.1 Content Relevance**
How relevant was the workshop content to your current role and responsibilities?

- [ ] Extremely Relevant (5) - Directly applicable to daily work
- [ ] Very Relevant (4) - Applicable with some adaptation
- [ ] Moderately Relevant (3) - Some applicable elements
- [ ] Slightly Relevant (2) - Limited applicability
- [ ] Not Relevant (1) - No clear application

**2.2 Content Quality**
How would you rate the overall quality of the workshop content?

- [ ] Excellent (5) - Comprehensive, accurate, well-organized
- [ ] Very Good (4) - High quality with minor gaps
- [ ] Good (3) - Adequate quality, met basic needs
- [ ] Fair (2) - Acceptable but noticeable quality issues
- [ ] Poor (1) - Significant quality problems

**2.3 Content Depth**
Was the depth of content coverage appropriate for your needs?

- [ ] Perfect Depth (5) - Exactly the right level of detail
- [ ] Mostly Appropriate (4) - Good depth with minor adjustments needed
- [ ] Adequate (3) - Acceptable level of depth
- [ ] Too Shallow (2) - Needed more detail and examples
- [ ] Too Deep (1) - Too much detail, overwhelming

**2.4 Content Currency**
How current and up-to-date was the workshop content?

- [ ] Very Current (5) - Latest trends and best practices
- [ ] Mostly Current (4) - Recent information with some updates needed
- [ ] Adequately Current (3) - Reasonably up-to-date
- [ ] Somewhat Outdated (2) - Some outdated information
- [ ] Outdated (1) - Significantly outdated content

**2.5 Practical Application**
How practical and actionable was the content presented?

- [ ] Highly Practical (5) - Can implement immediately
- [ ] Very Practical (4) - Can implement with minor adjustments
- [ ] Moderately Practical (3) - Some immediately useful elements
- [ ] Somewhat Practical (2) - Limited immediate applicability
- [ ] Not Practical (1) - Theoretical only, no clear application

**2.6 Example Quality**
How helpful were the examples and case studies used?

- [ ] Extremely Helpful (5) - Excellent, relevant examples
- [ ] Very Helpful (4) - Good examples that clarified concepts
- [ ] Moderately Helpful (3) - Adequate examples
- [ ] Somewhat Helpful (2) - Limited value from examples
- [ ] Not Helpful (1) - Poor or irrelevant examples

### Section 3: Facilitation Effectiveness

**3.1 Facilitator Knowledge**
How knowledgeable did the facilitator appear to be about the subject matter?

- [ ] Expert Level (5) - Exceptional knowledge and expertise
- [ ] Very Knowledgeable (4) - Strong knowledge base
- [ ] Knowledgeable (3) - Adequate subject matter knowledge
- [ ] Somewhat Knowledgeable (2) - Limited knowledge evident
- [ ] Not Knowledgeable (1) - Insufficient knowledge

**3.2 Facilitation Skills**
How effective were the facilitator's workshop management and facilitation skills?

- [ ] Excellent (5) - Masterful facilitation throughout
- [ ] Very Good (4) - Strong facilitation with minor areas for improvement
- [ ] Good (3) - Adequate facilitation skills
- [ ] Fair (2) - Noticeable facilitation challenges
- [ ] Poor (1) - Significant facilitation problems

**3.3 Participation Encouragement**
How well did the facilitator encourage participation from all attendees?

- [ ] Excellent (5) - Everyone felt encouraged to participate
- [ ] Very Good (4) - Most people felt included
- [ ] Good (3) - Adequate participation encouragement
- [ ] Fair (2) - Limited encouragement of participation
- [ ] Poor (1) - Failed to encourage broad participation

**3.4 Question Handling**
How effectively did the facilitator handle questions and discussions?

- [ ] Excellent (5) - All questions handled expertly
- [ ] Very Good (4) - Most questions handled well
- [ ] Good (3) - Adequate question handling
- [ ] Fair (2) - Some questions poorly handled
- [ ] Poor (1) - Ineffective question handling

**3.5 Time Management**
How well did the facilitator manage time and keep the workshop on schedule?

- [ ] Excellent (5) - Perfect time management throughout
- [ ] Very Good (4) - Good time management with minor adjustments
- [ ] Good (3) - Adequate time management
- [ ] Fair (2) - Some time management issues
- [ ] Poor (1) - Significant time management problems

### Section 4: Learning and Value

**4.1 Learning Objectives Achievement**
How well did the workshop achieve its stated learning objectives?

- [ ] Completely Achieved (5) - All objectives fully met
- [ ] Mostly Achieved (4) - Most objectives met
- [ ] Partially Achieved (3) - Some objectives met
- [ ] Minimally Achieved (2) - Few objectives met
- [ ] Not Achieved (1) - Objectives not met

**4.2 New Knowledge Acquisition**
How much new knowledge or insight did you gain from this workshop?

- [ ] Significant Learning (5) - Learned a great deal
- [ ] Considerable Learning (4) - Learned quite a bit
- [ ] Moderate Learning (3) - Learned some new things
- [ ] Limited Learning (2) - Learned very little
- [ ] No Learning (1) - No new knowledge gained

**4.3 Confidence Building**
How much did this workshop increase your confidence in applying the concepts covered?

- [ ] Significantly Increased (5) - Much more confident
- [ ] Considerably Increased (4) - Noticeably more confident
- [ ] Moderately Increased (3) - Somewhat more confident
- [ ] Slightly Increased (2) - A little more confident
- [ ] No Increase (1) - No change in confidence

**4.4 Implementation Intent**
How likely are you to implement what you learned in this workshop?

- [ ] Definitely Will Implement (5) - Already planning implementation
- [ ] Very Likely (4) - Strong intention to implement
- [ ] Somewhat Likely (3) - Will consider implementation
- [ ] Unlikely (2) - Limited intention to implement
- [ ] Will Not Implement (1) - No intention to implement

### Section 5: Logistics and Environment

**5.1 Workshop Duration**
Was the workshop duration appropriate for the content covered?

- [ ] Perfect Length (5) - Exactly the right amount of time
- [ ] Mostly Appropriate (4) - Good length with minor adjustments needed
- [ ] Adequate (3) - Acceptable duration
- [ ] Too Long (2) - Could have been shorter
- [ ] Too Short (1) - Needed more time

**5.2 Physical Environment** (For in-person workshops)
How would you rate the physical workshop environment (room, seating, temperature, etc.)?

- [ ] Excellent (5) - Ideal environment for learning
- [ ] Very Good (4) - Good environment with minor issues
- [ ] Good (3) - Adequate learning environment
- [ ] Fair (2) - Some environmental challenges
- [ ] Poor (1) - Environmental issues hindered learning

**5.3 Technology and Materials**
How effective were the technology and materials used in the workshop?

- [ ] Excellent (5) - All technology and materials worked perfectly
- [ ] Very Good (4) - Minor technology/material issues
- [ ] Good (3) - Adequate technology and materials
- [ ] Fair (2) - Some technology/material problems
- [ ] Poor (1) - Significant technology/material issues

**5.4 Workshop Schedule**
How well did the workshop schedule (timing, breaks, pace) work for you?

- [ ] Perfect Schedule (5) - Ideal timing and pacing
- [ ] Very Good Schedule (4) - Good with minor adjustments needed
- [ ] Good Schedule (3) - Adequate scheduling
- [ ] Fair Schedule (2) - Some scheduling issues
- [ ] Poor Schedule (1) - Significant scheduling problems

### Section 6: Future Recommendations

**6.1 Follow-up Interest**
Would you be interested in follow-up sessions or advanced workshops on this topic?

- [ ] Very Interested (5) - Definitely want more
- [ ] Interested (4) - Would likely attend
- [ ] Somewhat Interested (3) - Might attend
- [ ] Slightly Interested (2) - Probably wouldn't attend
- [ ] Not Interested (1) - No interest in follow-up

**6.2 Workshop Format Preference**
What workshop format would you prefer for future similar workshops?

- [ ] In-Person Only - Prefer face-to-face interaction
- [ ] Virtual Only - Prefer online convenience
- [ ] Hybrid - Combination of in-person and virtual
- [ ] Flexible - Either format works well
- [ ] No Preference - Format doesn't matter

**6.3 Optimal Workshop Length**
What would be your preferred length for future workshops on this topic?

- [ ] Half Day (4 hours or less)
- [ ] Full Day (6-8 hours)
- [ ] Two Days (12-16 hours total)
- [ ] Multiple Short Sessions (spread over several weeks)
- [ ] Self-Paced Online Learning

[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/workshop-satisfaction-survey.md#pre-survey-preparation]

### Pre-Survey Preparation

**Communication Strategy:**

- Announce evaluation during workshop opening
- Explain importance of feedback for continuous improvement
- Emphasize confidentiality and anonymous nature
- Set expectation for post-workshop survey completion

**Technical Setup:**

- Test survey platform functionality
- Ensure mobile-friendly design for accessibility
- Set up automated reminder system
- Prepare offline backup options if needed
page_texts.15:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/workshop-satisfaction-survey.md#survey-distribution]

### Survey Distribution

**Timing:**

- **Immediate Distribution**: Send survey link before participants leave
- **Follow-up Reminder**: 24-hour reminder for incomplete responses
- **Final Reminder**: 48-hour final reminder
- **Survey Closure**: Close survey after 72 hours

**Distribution Methods:**

- **Email**: Direct link to each participant
- **QR Code**: Quick scan option for mobile completion
- **Text Message**: Link via SMS for immediate access
- **Workshop Platform**: Integration with virtual workshop platform
page_texts.16:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/workshop-satisfaction-survey.md#response-rate-optimization]

### Response Rate Optimization

**Incentive Strategies:**

- **Completion Recognition**: Certificate or acknowledgment for feedback
- **Lottery Entry**: Chance to win small prizes for completed surveys
- **Group Feedback**: Promise to share aggregated results with participants
- **Improvement Commitment**: Clear statement about how feedback will be used

**Barrier Reduction:**

- **Mobile Optimization**: Ensure easy completion on phones and tablets
- **Progress Indicators**: Show completion progress throughout survey
- **Save and Resume**: Ability to complete survey in multiple sessions
- **Multiple Languages**: Translate survey for non-English speakers when needed

---
page_texts.18:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/workshop-satisfaction-survey.md#quantitative-analysis]

### Quantitative Analysis

**Response Rate Calculation:**

- Total Responses ÷ Total Invitations × 100 = Response Rate
- Target: 70%+ response rate for valid results
- Track response rates by participant type, workshop type, and facilitator

**Satisfaction Scoring:**

- Calculate mean scores for each question and section
- Identify questions with highest and lowest scores
- Calculate Net Promoter Score (NPS) from recommendation likelihood
- Compare scores across different workshop types and facilitators

**Statistical Analysis:**

- **Correlation Analysis**: Relationships between different satisfaction factors
- **Trend Analysis**: Changes in satisfaction over time
- **Comparative Analysis**: Differences between workshop types, facilitators, audiences
- **Regression Analysis**: Factors that most predict overall satisfaction
page_texts.19:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/workshop-satisfaction-survey.md#qualitative-analysis]

### Qualitative Analysis

**Thematic Coding:**

- **Initial Coding**: Identify key themes in open-ended responses
- **Category Development**: Group similar themes into categories
- **Frequency Analysis**: Count mentions of different themes
- **Sentiment Analysis**: Positive, negative, and neutral comments

**Quote Selection:**

- **Representative Quotes**: Examples that illustrate common themes
- **Extreme Cases**: Particularly positive or negative feedback
- **Improvement Ideas**: Specific suggestions for enhancement
- **Success Stories**: Examples of high value and impact
page_texts.20:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/workshop-satisfaction-survey.md#report-generation]

### Report Generation

**Executive Dashboard:**

```
Workshop Satisfaction Summary
---------------------------
Overall Rating: 4.2/5.0 (84%)
Net Promoter Score: +32
Response Rate: 76% (23/30 participants)
Recommendation: Continue with minor improvements

Top Strengths:
• Facilitator knowledge and expertise
• Content relevance to daily work
• Interactive activities and engagement

Improvement Opportunities:
• Workshop duration (too long)
• Technology setup and reliability
• Follow-up resource provision
```

**Detailed Analysis Report:**

- **Methodology**: Survey design and administration approach
- **Response Demographics**: Participant characteristics and response rates
- **Quantitative Findings**: Statistical analysis and key metrics
- **Qualitative Insights**: Themes and representative quotes
- **Trends and Comparisons**: Historical and comparative analysis
- **Recommendations**: Specific actions for improvement

---
page_texts.22:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/workshop-satisfaction-survey.md#immediate-actions]

### Immediate Actions

**Quick Fixes (Within 1 week):**

- Address logistical issues (room, technology, materials)
- Modify workshop timing and schedule
- Update presentation materials and examples
- Adjust facilitation approach based on feedback

**Template Updates (Within 1 month):**

- Revise workshop templates and guides
- Update participant materials and handouts
- Modify pre-workshop communication
- Enhance follow-up resource provision
page_texts.23:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/workshop-satisfaction-survey.md#long-term-improvements]

### Long-term Improvements

**Process Enhancement (Within 3 months):**

- Redesign workshop activities and flow
- Develop new content modules
- Create additional support resources
- Implement new technology solutions

**Capability Development (Within 6 months):**

- Facilitator training and coaching
- Template and methodology refinement
- Evaluation system enhancement
- Best practice documentation and sharing
page_texts.24:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/workshop-satisfaction-survey.md#success-tracking]

### Success Tracking

**Improvement Metrics:**

- **Satisfaction Trend**: Quarter-over-quarter satisfaction score improvement
- **Response Quality**: Increase in detailed, constructive feedback
- **Implementation Rate**: Percentage of suggestions actually implemented
- **Facilitator Development**: Improvement in individual facilitator scores

**Value Demonstration:**

- **Before/After Comparison**: Satisfaction scores before and after improvements
- **Success Stories**: Examples of significant improvements based on feedback
- **ROI Calculation**: Value of improvements relative to evaluation investment
- **Stakeholder Communication**: Regular updates on evaluation-driven enhancements
